query: Which causal inference frameworks (interrupted time series, synthetic controls, causal-impact) and assumptions are most appropriate to attribute events to shifts in sentiment?

response.query: Which causal inference frameworks (interrupted time series, synthetic controls, causal-impact) and assumptions are most appropriate to attribute events to shifts in sentiment?
response.answer: Interrupted time series, synthetic controls, and causal-impact are suitable for attributing events to shifts in sentiment, assuming stable pre-treatment trends and sufficient pre- and post-intervention data.
